trigger: I am being extorted at a checkpoint
description: What to do if officers at a checkpoint demand money to let you pass.

steps.text: Stay calm and polite; keep your hands visible.
You have a right to move freely in Nigeria (s.41); passing a checkpoint is not an offence.
No one may treat you in a degrading way or extort you (s.34(1)).
Do not hand over money quietly. Ask calmly what offence you have committed.
If it is safe, record the demand and note the location.
Note the officers' names, numbers, and the checkpoint.
Report extortion to the NHRC or the police complaint desk afterwards.

citations.source_name: 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
